reason: Las sombras originales se leen como rampas rectangulares, no sombras de personas que recuperan la vida.
strategy: Cambiar únicamente forma legible de las sombras, manteniendo contrato material literal, reparto, atuendos y separación.

shot.title: Regresar no borra
shot.visual: Wide dawn field composition, three LIVING adult men complete, uninjured and fully clothed. Jose in ivory short shirt and sand trousers stands apart at left; tall cream knee-TUNIC worker and stockier rust knee-TUNIC worker stand spaced at middle-right. Every head is almost-flat cut paper. THE MAGIC MUST BE CLEAR: on the ground in FRONT OF EACH WORKER lies his own SINGLE long charcoal PAPER SHADOW shaped like a COMPLETE HUMAN SIDE-PROFILE SILHOUETTE, with a distinct rounded HEAD, profile NOSE, shoulders, two arms close to body and two legs. These are flat shadows, not extra actual people. The head-and-shoulder END of each shadow has peeled upward only 20cm from the ground as a curved THIN PAPER edge; the feet-end remains visibly attached at the corresponding worker's feet. The raised HEAD SHAPE and cutout nose must be legible; shadows are NOT plain rectangles, ribbons, ramps or blank strips. Both actual men stand entirely on the ochre soil, not on ramps. A gap separates Jose from the two workers; hands down, no magic rays or celebration. Rich broad paper-ground sheets, thin paper fence and small sage bushes, dawn light. No lying bodies, wounds, gore, fragments, ghosts, halos or duplicate people.
shot.transition_to_next: Corte al siguiente episodio, permitiendo salto temporal explícito de la VO.

magic_in_the_ordinary.impossible_behavior: Ground-shadow sheets begin to lift toward their restored living figures.
magic_in_the_ordinary.narrative_effect: Restitution is visible without showing death or celebrating violence.
magic_in_the_ordinary.agency: Agencia correspondiente al relato; no poderes ni símbolos tradicionales nuevos. La forma de papel es traducción editorial.
magic_in_the_ordinary.physical_translation: slightly lifted attached paper shadows; two standing workers; Jose standing apart; clearing and dawn ridge
magic_in_the_ordinary.visible_test: Three intact standing people; two connected partly raised shadow edges, clear distance from Jose.

motion_contract.camera: Avance muy leve o desplazamiento lateral corto para revelar profundidad; definir ejecución después de medir voz.
motion_contract.allowed: Un gesto y movimiento ambiental mínimo en fase posterior, no se genera ahora.
motion_contract.forbidden: No morphing, rostro volumétrico, cambio de vestuario, nuevos seres, violencia o pérdida de papel.
